scope: One warmed process per mode; one paragraph CACHE PROBE; 12 RuntimeError failures after actual paragraph drawing; gc.collect before final measurement.
baseline: The files_only mode simulates cleanup that closes font readers but omits fpdf2 SubsetMap cache clearing. It is not a complete historical checkout comparison.
metric: tracemalloc current Python heap minus the pre-loop baseline after gc.collect; peak is tracemalloc peak since tracing began. Neither metric is RSS.
regression_tests: tests/test_pdf_font_lifecycle.py checks immediate real font file closure, weakref collection, existing output preservation, and reuse after failure.
limit: One sample per mode; no throughput, normal-case RSS, cross-platform, or package size improvement is claimed. Standalone private measurement calls retain their cache until the next conversion.
